items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE) Zero-Day
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source installations. Adobe is aware of active exploitation in the wild, with attacks starting on September 4, 2026.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for the issues addressed in this bulletin, aside from CVE-2026-75650.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update addresses critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could result in security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation.
